message.reasoning_content: We need to determine criminal charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: father (Zhang) asked hospital to abandon treatment and gave infants to a taxi driver to abandon. He is father, DNA shows paternity. He abandoned infants. Likely crime of "遗弃罪" (abandonment of a minor). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 260 (or 261?) Actually article 260: "遗弃被监护、扶养的未成年人、老年人、残疾人或者其他不能自理的人" is punishable. Also could be "故意杀人罪"? No, abandonment leading to death could be homicide, but here they were abandoned but not necessarily died. The crime is "遗弃罪". Also possibly "非法收养"? No. So answer: [罪名]遗弃罪<eoa>
